# Dialog: `jl-dialog`

A modal window over the page, for a task or a decision that needs full attention.

- Class `JlDialog`, a organism: `import { JlDialog } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/dialog

A modal on the browser's own dialog element: the page behind is inert, focus stays inside, Escape and a
click on the backdrop close it (unless persistent). Put the content in the default slot and the buttons in the
actions slot; the footer only shows when there are some. The body frames its content and lays out nothing: put a
form's fields in a jl-stack, which spaces them.

Open it with the open attribute, or show() from code; it emits close however it closed.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlDialog } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlDialog
  description="A short sentence under the heading."
  heading="Dialog heading"
>
  <p>The content of the dialog.</p>
  <JlButton slot="actions" label="Cancel" />
  <JlButton slot="actions" variant="primary" label="Confirm" />
</JlDialog>
```

```html
<jl-dialog
  description="A short sentence under the heading."
  heading="Dialog heading"
>
  <p>The content of the dialog.</p>
  <jl-button slot="actions" label="Cancel"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" label="Confirm"></jl-button>
</jl-dialog>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The title.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A sentence under the title.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'full'`, default `'md'`. The width: 400, 520, 820 pixels, or the whole window.
- `open` (attribute `open`): `boolean`, default `false`. Whether it is open.
- `persistent` (attribute `persistent`): `boolean`, default `false`. Escape and the backdrop do not close it, and it has no close button.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `open` (`onOpen` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The dialog opened.
- `close` (`onClose` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The dialog closed: a button, Escape, the backdrop or close().

## Slots

- The default slot: The content.
- `actions`: The buttons, at the bottom right.

## Methods

- `show(): void`: Opens the dialog.
- `close(): void`: Closes the dialog.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The native dialog element.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A dialog with actions

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-basic" variant="primary" label="Invite people"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-dialog class="basic" heading="Invite people" description="They get an email with a link to join the project.">
  <div class="stack">
    <jl-input type="email" icon="mail" placeholder="name@example.com"></jl-input>
    <p class="muted">Separate several addresses with commas.</p>
  </div>
  <jl-button slot="actions" label="Cancel"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" label="Send invites"></jl-button>
</jl-dialog>
```

```js
const dialog = root.querySelector('jl-dialog.basic');
root.querySelector('.open-basic').events.register('press', () => dialog.show());
for (const button of dialog.querySelectorAll('jl-button')) {
  button.events.register('press', () => dialog.close());
}
```

### Confirmation

Persistent: Escape and the backdrop do nothing; only its own buttons close it.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-danger" variant="danger" icon="trash" label="Delete project"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-dialog class="danger" size="sm" heading="Delete this project?" persistent>
  <p>The project and its 24 files are deleted for everyone. This cannot be undone.</p>
  <jl-button slot="actions" label="Keep it"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="danger" label="Delete"></jl-button>
</jl-dialog>
```

```js
const dialog = root.querySelector('jl-dialog.danger');
root.querySelector('.open-danger').events.register('press', () => dialog.show());
```

### Sizes

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="open-large" label="Open a large dialog"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-dialog class="large" size="lg" heading="Release notes" description="Version 0.1">
  <div class="stack">
    <p>The first release of jlib: atoms, molecules, organisms and templates on native Web Components.</p>
    <jl-code-block language="bash" code="npm install @syware/jlib @jadis/core"></jl-code-block>
  </div>
</jl-dialog>
```
